threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still stand by the curb waiting for a non-existent taxi instead of flagging down an Uber like the rest of us.
Caught a chatty group on the 12 last night; one lad was convinced the bus drivers know all the best late-night food spots. He might be onto something!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Waking up to the sound of spontaneous parties on the street—every Saturday morning feels like a little festival of life.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain will you find spontaneous raves in abandoned buildings with a full DJ setup, often just a text away from your friends.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell who's local when they dodge the BART delays and recommend the best taco shop, while the newcomers are still planning around the chaos.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy juggling on the 14 Muni while a woman serenaded him with an old soul tune. Only in SF do you get cabaret for your commute.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all of Gràcia is the same, but the vibe changes at every plaza. Each one tells a different story—especially at night.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their reluctance to try tapas at 11 PM. Locals know that's when the real socializing begins.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still step off the bus at the stop closest to your destination instead of walking a few minutes like everyone else.
Caught a night bus from Brixton yesterday. A guy was serenading the driver with old 90s R&B—totally made the ride feel like a reality show.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I spotted a kid riding his bike down the street, juggling oranges while his dog chased after him. Classic Neukölln chaos.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Friedrichshain, you can find public toilets with actual art inside—nothing like a mural on the wall while you do your business!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a true local knows the best taco stand changes its salsa every Sunday. Tourists grab the burritos, but we wait for the real flavor.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus with a guy loudly arguing about his lucky socks. He swears they’re the reason he hasn’t missed a day of work. Classic San Francisco.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think Gràcia is just for Gaudí. They miss the real charm in the tiny plazas where locals sip a café and catch up.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They stop to take photos of every single building, even the ones with graffiti. Locals just stroll past without a second glance.
